String: You cried alone in a bathroom stall.
You <fainted/collapsed/threw up/shrieked> and had to be carried out of the gym.
You grabbed the mic from the winner and said that you <actually didn't care/weren't bothered, like, at all/were fine with this outcome, actually/never wanted to win in the first place>.
You <gracefully/politely> <shook the winner's hand/congratulated the winner>.
You quietly whispered that the winner was <insult> as you walked off the stage.
You told the yearbook staff that you were just <happy/pleased/honored> to be <nominated/included/talked about>.

You kept your cool, but afterwards, you <screamed into a pillow/kicked a hole in the drywall/set your yearbook on fire/raged against the prom machine/went to a rage room and beat up furniture with a baseball bat>.
You pushed <fish flakes/shrimp juice/a bunch of chewed gum/half-eaten French fries/raw ground beef/rotted lettuce/a bag of dog poop/used condoms/used pads> through the vents in the winner's locker.
You <took a deep breath/counted to ten/clenched your fists/silently repeated the mantra "I am calm, I am fine"> and gave the crowd a fake smile.
You muttered that you wished the winner would turn into <a toad/a rat/a worm/a naked mole rat/a hagfish/a sea cucumber> on the spot.
You asked the winner if you could hold the crown for a moment, then <spat/wiped a booger/hocked a loogie> on it.

You locked yourself in <a bathroom stall/the gym locker room/a supply closet/the theater AV booth/an empty classroom/the cafeteria pantry> and listened to <musician> songs for <two/a couple of/three and a half> hours.
You had visions of dunking the winner in a vat of <tar/acid/liquid concrete/superglue/expired dairy milk/quicklime/Port-A-Potty sewage/septic tank runoff>.
You realized a few <hours/days/weeks/months> later that the crown hadn't even meant that much to you.

You spread a rumor that the winner only nabbed the crown by <tampering with the votes/flirting with the head of the prom committee/performing dark magic/promising the principal a sizable donation/threatening to leak the class president's nudes>.
You realized that the winner probably <wanted it more/cared way more about this/needed this more/campaigned for this harder/pined for the crown more> than you.

You told everyone that you didn't even want the crown, because it <was probably made in a factory by abused workers/looked cheap/looked tacky/didn't fit your head anyway/looked wrong with your complexion/would have given you an allergic reaction>.

You put on <"Tears In The Club" by FKA Twigs/Kesha's "Dancing With Tears In My Eyes"/"Less Than Zero" by the Weeknd/"Crying For No Reason" by Katy B/"If I Could Change Your Mind" by HAIM/"Crying on the Bathroom Floor" by MUNA/"Let Me Down Gently" by La Roux> and did a dramatic interpretive dance to demonstrate your pain.
You were <sad/upset/disappointed/crushed/crestfallen/angry/bitter/sulky> at first, but then figured that you wouldn't even remember this once you <graduated/got a job/got out of school>.
You challenged the winner to a <fistfight/duel/dance battle/rap battle/wrestling match/twerking match>, but the principal told you to <be quiet/shut up/cool it>.
